scope_guardrail: A fresh confirmatory experiment after an exposed aggregate null-feasibility failure. It inherits no v2 recovery credit, winner, metric, or authority. It may train only the registered MLP0/1 tensor programs; it may not train the base model, ship, basis, or any prior artifact.
exposed_retry1_facts: The unified scorer and unchanged canonical K4608 full-native gates passed.
The true B-E selector found at least one positive-recovery candidate with copy worsening <=0.01.
No shuffled B-E candidate satisfied copy worsening <=0.01, up to the integrity caveat that non-finite comparisons also evaluate false.
No numerical metric, winner, family, rank/K, price, result, artifact, or authority receipt was serialized.

unchanged_real_program_contract.interfaces_objectives_grammars_grids_pri: Exactly compiler-v2 A-E, including state-complete p, Euclidean/causal affine, Euclidean/causal native products, registered ranks/K/lambdas, Fisher floor, Schur intercept, standalone prices, deterministic seeds, and poison semantics.
unchanged_real_program_contract.selector: Among finite B-E candidates with validation recovery >0 and copy worsening <=0.01, find best recovery; retain recovery >=0.99*best; select by fewer standalone reals, fewer Hadamard products, family B,C,D,E, smaller rank/K, larger lambda, then name.
unchanged_real_program_contract.failure: An empty/non-finite real bank or no positive copy-admissible B-E candidate is a terminal clean selection failure. Full-native, A, mean, or shuffle can never substitute.
unchanged_real_program_contract.absolute_gates: All original real-program validation/final recovery, no-free-rider, interaction, OOD/stratum, copy, novel-token, gauge, price, poison, component-tree, and integrity gates remain conjunctive. Beating a control alone earns no credit.

selection_permissive_nondeployable_shuff.fit: Permute compiler-fit p labels only by the same seeded equal-size document blocks. Keep z, live mo, adjoints, rows, families, grids, seeds, search budget, objectives, and price functions unchanged.
selection_permissive_nondeployable_shuff.finite_bank: C is every finite B-E shuffled candidate. Empty C or any required non-finite metric is an integrity failure.
selection_permissive_nondeployable_shuff.total_selector: Let r*=max recovery over C. If r*>0 retain r>=0.99*r*. If r*<=0 retain exact recovery maximizers. Apply the unchanged standalone-price/Hadamard/family/size/lambda/name tie-break. Copy collateral is never eligibility for this nondeployable null.
selection_permissive_nondeployable_shuff.reporting: Serialize every shuffled validation metric and price before selection. Fully report selected-null copy harm and price. Also report the old copy-constrained selector as descriptive sensitivity: if empty, record emptiness and continue; it can never change selection or claims.
selection_permissive_nondeployable_shuff.interpretation: This is a weakly more permissive validation search null, not a collateral-matched null and not guaranteed to be a stronger final comparator after price tie-breaking or distribution shift. It licenses only a pipeline-level label-alignment comparison.
forbidden_claims: equal-complexity effect unless P_T=P_S or a separate price-matched comparison is preregistered; P_T<=P_S licenses only no-greater-price wording

sequential_control_composition.true_pipeline: Freeze true Q0 on v2.1 validation; regenerate MLP1 fit/validation states under true Q0; then freeze true Q1.
sequential_control_composition.shuffle_pipeline: Freeze shuffle Q0 independently on v2.1 validation; regenerate MLP1 fit/validation states under that frozen shuffle Q0; permute only MLP1 fit p labels by the registered document-block rule; then freeze shuffle Q1 with the total null selector.
sequential_control_composition.mean_pipeline: Freeze M0 as the compiler-fit mean p0; deploy M0 while regenerating site-1 compiler-fit/validation states; freeze M1 as the resulting compiler-fit mean p1. The final mean control is the independently autoregressive M0M1N pipeline, never a mixed true/mean or shuffle/mean arm.
sequential_control_composition.forbidden: Never train shuffle Q1 under true Q0, never mix true/shuffle sites, and never reuse old compiler-validation outcomes.

fresh_currency.fit: Explicitly reuse old compiler_fit as v2.1 training only; retry1 exposed no fit tensor, parameter, metric, or winner.
fresh_currency.spent_validation: Old compiler_validation is permanently forbidden for v2.1 fit, selection, thresholding, direction audit, final scoring, or authority.
fresh_currency.validation: Prospectively redesignate old compiler_final as compiler_validation_v21 under a new committed/pushed row authority before its first v2.1 role-mapped load. Accurate provenance: preflights deserialized it for integrity/disjointness only; it was never model-forwarded, scored, fit, selected on, or outcome-summarized.
fresh_currency.final: Harvest and freeze 192 wholly new compiler_final_v21 rows at deterministic skip 39000, document/full-row/prefix32-disjoint from every prior role, before any v2.1 validation forward. Never deserialize final until true Q0/Q1, shuffle Q0/Q1, strata, prices, and receipts are frozen.

complete_ledgers: Write nonauthorizing pending candidate/control ledgers atomically before each selector. A selector failure preserves the ledger and manifest but can never create a training/scoring authority receipt. No metric may exist only in memory at a selection boundary.

final_control_gate.arms_and_gain: Score NNN, true T0T1N, shuffle S0S1N, and mean M0M1N on identical new-final rows and valid positions in the frozen unified scorer. Define gain(A)=CE(NNN)-CE(A).
final_control_gate.primary: In the shared document-cluster bootstrap require gain(T0T1N)-max(gain(M0M1N),gain(S0S1N)) to be positive at the point estimate and 95% lower bound, recomputing the max within every draw.
final_control_gate.label_alignment: This gate is conjunctive, not optional: for each final row compute KL(OON||S0S1N)-KL(OON||T0T1N) on the same valid tokens in the frozen scorer, where OON is the common projected-oracle MLP0/1 teacher with deployed MLP2. Require the pooled point estimate and shared document-cluster 95% lower bound to be positive.
final_control_gate.price: Let P_T=P(T0)+P(T1) and P_S=P(S0)+P(S1), using the same registered standalone per-site basis-accounting convention. Report both. P_T<=P_S licenses only 'at no greater registered standalone price'; literal equal-complexity wording requires P_T=P_S or a separately preregistered price-matched comparison.
final_control_gate.wording: At most: the correct-fit-label selection pipeline outperforms this document-block p-label-shuffle training pipeline, conditional on every unchanged absolute compiler gate.

authority_lifecycle: Row protocol/preparer/test are committed and pushed before any role-mapped validation load or new-final harvest. Site programs/results/manifests remain non-self-authorizing. Only last-written receipts after hook restoration, inertness, outer model return, component/protected checks, exact ledgers, and output hashes may license the next site or final scoring. Final authority is written last after one final evaluation with no fallback or tuning.
